title: Single Command ON Request
purpose: Cover a canonical control-direction command path with TypeID 45 and an ON-style SCO value, suitable for mutating command qualifier bits while preserving valid 104 structure.
expected_behavior: Parses as a 104 I-format C_SC_NA_1 single command request with one information object and an ON command state; acceptance depends on application policy and link state rather than frame validity.
constraints_preserved: TypeID 45 for C_SC_NA_1 taken from supplied function reference
Length octet 0x0e matches 14 bytes following it
Single-object ASDU uses VSQ=1, common address 0x0001, IOA 0x000001
Command payload is one SCO byte, enabling later mutation of select/execute and state bits while preserving structure
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; not an exploit payload. Replaces prior malformed hybrid ON frame with a compact valid structural baseline.
